mcqs.question: The Central Government General Pool Office Accommodation Project in Amaravati was approved with approximately what cost and built-up area?
mcqs.explanation: The Amaravati Central Government office complex has an estimated cost of ₹1,299 crore and a built-up area of 23.2 lakh sq ft. The other options combine figures associated with the Swarna Andhra vision, wildlife proposals or natural farming.

mcqs.question:
With reference to the Swarna Andhra @2047 Vision, consider the following statements:
1. It advocates human capital-driven development aligned with Viksit Bharat 2047.
2. Andhra Pradesh claimed investments of more than ₹23 lakh crore in the last two years.
3. It is based on a 15% annual growth target already achieved during 2014–2019.
mcqs.explanation: Statements 1 and 2 are correct: the model is human capital-driven and aligned with Viksit Bharat 2047, while the investment claim exceeds ₹23 lakh crore in the last two years. Statement 3 is incorrect because 15% is the growth target, whereas the CAGR during 2014–2019 was 13.5%.

mcqs.question: In the Swarna Andhra @2047 Vision, what policy was linked to Andhra Pradesh’s total fertility rate falling below 1.5?
mcqs.explanation: A total fertility rate below 1.5 was linked with the Population Management Policy. Water Security, Product Perfection and Deep Tech are separate guiding principles under the vision.

mcqs.keyword: Seven basic necessities and Zero Poverty P4
mcqs.question:
Match the components associated with the Swarna Andhra @2047 Vision in List-I with their descriptions in List-II.

List-I
(a) Housing
(b) Digital connectivity
(c) DBT
(d) Zero Poverty P4

List-II
(i) One of the seven basic necessities
(ii) One of the seven basic necessities
(iii) One of the seven basic necessities
(iv) Support from the top 10% to the bottom 20% through philanthropy and mentorship
mcqs.explanation: Housing, digital connectivity and DBT are included among the seven basic necessities. Zero Poverty P4 envisages the top 10% supporting the bottom 20% through philanthropy and mentorship, giving the pairs a-i, b-ii, c-iii and d-iv.

mcqs.question:
Match the components of the AP–IFMR MoU in List-I with the corresponding details in List-II.

List-I
(a) Parties to the MoU
(b) Role of the mission cells
(c) Initial missions
(d) Growth target

List-II
(i) Zero Poverty, Water Security and Deep Tech
(ii) 15% annual growth
(iii) AP Planning Department and IFMR, a constituent of Krea University
(iv) Accelerate GSDP, monitor 10 strategic principles, and undertake field studies and evaluation
mcqs.explanation: The MoU was between the AP Planning Department and IFMR, a constituent of Krea University. Its mission cells were to accelerate GSDP, monitor the ten strategic principles and conduct field studies and evaluation; the initial missions were Zero Poverty, Water Security and Deep Tech, with a 15% annual growth target.

mcqs.question: With reference to the outcome of the Chief Minister’s Singapore visit, identify the incorrect statement regarding Google’s proposed involvement in Andhra Pradesh.
options: Google was invited to the Sanjeevani healthcare project and to establish AI and cloud centres in universities.
Google was invited to the Sanjeevani healthcare project and to establish a branch or satellite campus in Amaravati.
Google was invited to develop logistics parks and a supply-chain city.
Google was invited to establish a Centre of Excellence.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement is that Google was invited to establish a branch or satellite campus in Amaravati. The Google invitation concerned the Sanjeevani healthcare project and AI/cloud centres in universities; the branch campus was associated with NUS, while the Centre of Excellence was associated with UN-Habitat.

mcqs.question: Whom did the Chief Minister meet during his Singapore visit as India’s High Commissioner to Singapore?
mcqs.explanation: The Chief Minister met Shilpak Ambule, India’s High Commissioner to Singapore. Karan Bajwa, Anacláudia Rossbach and Prof. Tan Eng Chye were associated with other engagements during the visit.

mcqs.question: Natural farming in Andhra Pradesh covered approximately what area in the context of the Chief Minister’s Singapore visit?
mcqs.explanation: Natural farming was reported across nearly two million acres in Andhra Pradesh. The other figures refer respectively to the Clean Godavari initiative, the Amaravati office complex and tiger-reserve base camps.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements about the Clean Godavari initiative:
1. The Centre assured support for the Mission Godavari Clean Project on the lines of Namami Gange.
2. A CPCB team will assess Godavari pollution before the next Godavari Pushkarams.
3. The Pushkaram theme is “Swachh Godavari, Pavitra Pushkaralu”.
mcqs.explanation: All three statements are correct. The Centre assured support on the lines of Namami Gange, the CPCB team will assess pollution before the next Godavari Pushkarams, and the stated theme is “Swachh Godavari, Pavitra Pushkaralu”.

mcqs.question: How many model panchayats along the Godavari were identified under the Viksit Bharat–Gram Gaurav programme?
mcqs.explanation: The programme covers 260 model panchayats along the Godavari. The figures 150 and 90 relate to tiger-reserve base camps, while 50 relates to Indian Gaurs.

mcqs.question: Kumki elephants were proposed to be brought from which State to address human–elephant conflict in Parvathipuram-Manyam district?
mcqs.explanation: Kumki elephants were proposed to be brought from Odisha for addressing human–elephant conflict in Parvathipuram-Manyam district. Madhya Pradesh and Maharashtra were associated with other wildlife proposals, while Andhra Pradesh was the receiving State.
